findings.pr_title: S3 store: versioned-object support and multi-region reads
findings.summary: example-app now sits in front of your existing S3 bucket and separates compute from storage, so platform teams keep their data plane where it is while adding encrypted vector search.

evidence.note: Tiered storage claim: S3 is the tier for cloud-native and multi-region deployments.

findings.pr_title: RBAC: per-user keys scoped to read/write
findings.summary: The holder of the root index key can mint per-user keys scoped to read and/or write, enforced by the encrypted-index engine on every request. Shipped in v0.17.0.

evidence.note: ICP audits ask 'who could read this vector?' — per-user key scoping answers it.
